title: Lichtenbaum–Schlessinger complex computes the cotangent complex through degree minus two

standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Simplicial polynomial resolutions, simplicial identities, ordinary Tor exact sequences and tensor-product spectral sequences, the cotangent transitivity framework. The explicit two-skeleton, naive comparison and degree-two local calculation are retained as authored support rather than granted free.

core_obligations: Construct the comparison chain map using the bimodule biderivation and its degree-two relation class.
Identify degree-two cotangent homology with relations modulo trivial relations and track the transgression to prove the constructed map induces that isomorphism.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the comparison chain map using the bimodule biderivation and its degree-two relation class.

difficulty_reason: The new obligation is not just computing three groups: one must construct a compatible chain map and match its degree-two component to the Tor transgression. The retained explicit local calculations make that H2 obligation concrete.
